workflow_rationale: Net-new feature adding user-facing profile UI to the Flutter app. Requires creating new screen, extending data model, and integrating with existing navigation. Multiple new files and integration points.

phases.name: Data Model Extension
phases.description: Extend AppSettings model with profile-related fields and update Hive adapter

subtasks.description: Add profile fields (displayName, themeMode, notificationsEnabled) to AppSettings model
implementation_notes: Add String displayName field with default 'User'
Add String themeMode field with default 'system' (store as string, parse to AppThemeMode)
Add bool notificationsEnabled field with default true
Update copyWith method with new nullable parameters
Update fromJson/toJson for new fields with graceful fallbacks for missing data
Update defaultSettings factory to include new field defaults
subtasks.notes: Successfully added profile fields (displayName and notificationsEnabled) to AppSettings model. Updated constructor, fromJson, toJson, and copyWith methods with graceful fallbacks for backward compatibility. Note: themeMode field already existed in the model.

subtasks.description: Update AppSettingsAdapter for Hive to handle new fields
implementation_notes: Adapter uses JSON serialization via toJson/fromJson
No changes needed if model's fromJson handles missing fields gracefully
Verify adapter still works with updated model structure
subtasks.notes: Successfully created AppSettingsAdapter for Hive using JSON serialization pattern. The adapter leverages AppSettings.fromJson/toJson methods, which already handle the new profile fields (displayName, notificationsEnabled) with graceful fallback defaults for backward compatibility. Also added hive and hive_flutter dependencies to pubspec.yaml.

phases.name: PreferencesService Extension
phases.description: Add profile-specific convenience methods to PreferencesService

subtasks.description: Add profile-specific helper methods to PreferencesService
implementation_notes: Add updateDisplayName(String name) convenience method
Add updateThemeMode(String mode) convenience method
Add updateNotificationsEnabled(bool enabled) convenience method
These wrap settings.copyWith() + updateSettings() pattern
subtasks.notes: Successfully added profile-specific helper methods (updateDisplayName, updateNotificationsEnabled) to PreferencesService. Also added corresponding getter methods (displayName, notificationsEnabled). Methods follow the same pattern as existing Theme Helpers, using copyWith() + updateSettings() for consistency.

phases.name: Profile Screen Implementation
phases.description: Create the new ProfileScreen with unique visual design

subtasks.description: Create ProfileScreen with gradient header and avatar section
implementation_notes: Use StatefulWidget pattern from settings_screen.dart
Create gradient header using AppThemeExtension.of(context).primaryGradient
Add CircleAvatar with initials from displayName
Add display name below avatar with edit capability
Use AppSpacing and AppRadius tokens for consistency
subtasks.notes: Successfully created ProfileScreen with gradient header and avatar section. Implemented StatefulWidget pattern following Material Design 3 guidelines. Features include: gradient header (primary to primaryContainer), avatar with user initials, editable display name via dialog, and notifications toggle. Also created AppThemeMode enum with display name and icon extensions, and added path_provider dependency to pubspec.yaml.

subtasks.description: Add theme selector section with visual theme preview
implementation_notes: Create theme selector using AppThemeMode enum
Use displayName and icon from AppThemeModeExtension
Show visual preview chips or radio tiles for each theme
Theme changes should apply immediately and persist
subtasks.notes: Added theme selector section with visual theme preview cards. The implementation includes a Card widget with three theme options (Light, Dark, System) displayed as interactive preview cards. Each card shows the theme icon, name, and visual selection state with borders, background colors, and check icons. The theme selector is integrated into the Appearance section of the profile screen.

subtasks.description: Add image recognition settings section (consolidate from settings_screen)
implementation_notes: Copy image recognition settings section from settings_screen.dart
Include provider selection (TensorFlow Lite / ML Kit)
Include confidence threshold slider
Include heuristic fallback toggle
Follow same update pattern as settings_screen
subtasks.notes: Successfully added image recognition settings section to profile_screen.dart. Implemented comprehensive settings including provider selection (TensorFlow Lite/ML Kit) with radio buttons, confidence threshold slider (10-90%), maximum tags slider (1-10), and heuristic fallback toggle. All settings follow the existing _updateSettings() pattern for persistence and use consistent Material Design 3 styling with colorScheme and textTheme. The section is properly integrated into the profile screen layout between Appearance and App Info sections.

subtasks.description: Add app info section with version, about, and feedback
implementation_notes: Add App Info section header
Add Version ListTile showing app version
Add About ListTile with showAboutDialog
Add Send Feedback ListTile (can open email or show dialog)
Use package_info_plus or hardcode version for now

subtasks.description: Add unique visual polish (animated cards, subtle effects)
implementation_notes: Add FadeTransition or AnimatedOpacity for section appearance
Consider gradient-decorated cards for settings groups
Add subtle shadows using AppShadows tokens
Ensure animations are smooth and not distracting
Keep it simple - just enough for 'unique' feel

phases.name: Navigation Integration
phases.description: Add profile screen access to main navigation

subtasks.description: Add Profile tab to MainTabScreen navigation
implementation_notes: Import ProfileScreen
Add 5th tab for Profile with person icon
Update TabController length from 4 to 5
Add ProfileScreen() to TabBarView children
Consider using Icon(Icons.person) for the tab

phases.name: Integration & Theme Wiring
phases.description: Wire theme changes to app-wide theme and verify end-to-end functionality

subtasks.description: Wire theme preference to MaterialApp theme mode
implementation_notes: MyApp needs to read theme preference from PreferencesService
Use AppTheme.buildTheme with selected AppThemeMode
May need to convert MyApp to StatefulWidget to handle theme changes
Consider using ValueListenableBuilder or Provider for reactive updates
Theme changes should apply immediately without restart

steps: Launch app and navigate to Profile tab
Verify gradient header displays with avatar
Edit display name and verify it persists
Change theme and verify it applies app-wide
Restart app and verify all settings persisted

implementation_notes: Run flutter run and manually test all flows
Verify no console errors during navigation
Test on both iOS and Android if possible
Verify theme changes apply immediately

acceptance_criteria: All flutter analyze passes with no issues
verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk UI feature with no security, API, or database implications. Single Flutter service with estimated 6 files. Minimal validation with static analysis and existing tests.

checks: Profile screen renders on iOS Simulator
Profile screen renders on Android Emulator
Theme switching works on both platforms
New AppSettings fields serialize correctly to Hive
Existing settings migrate gracefully (missing fields use defaults)
